propositions: A parameterized CI harness is needed to measure raw-output distributions across (provider, model, directive) cells with live API calls to Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI.
The sentinel directive changes model output layout from mixed fenced/prose to 100% prose on Anthropic/Bedrock, improving parse success rates across all arms.
The harness must enforce a predeclared per-run call budget cap, skip cells with missing credentials without failing, and capture/score deterministically against committed E2 fixtures.
Unit tests validate scorer golden-count reproduction, credential-absent skip paths, and call-budget enforcement before any network calls are made.
A workflow_dispatch job uploads raw replies and score tables as artifacts for operator review, with per-provider secret scoping inherited from external-integration.yml.
The live measurement confirms the epic thesis: sentinel directive raises parse success (8/20→11/20 Anthropic, 9/20→11/20 Bedrock, 18/20→19/20 OpenAI) and standardizes layout to prose.
